quests.title: Magician Louie - Ancient Legacy
quests.location: Mirage Island Field 2 - Cliff of Fate
quests.prereqText: Magician, Priest or Witch, Radiant Strike (Lv.5), Light Wave (Lv.5)
steps: Talk to Magician Louie at Mirage Island Field 2 - Cliff of Fate.
Get 10x Ancient Feather Pen: drilled in Mirage Island Field 1 / 5 / 6.
Get 10x Papyrus: drilled in Pyramid Dungeon Halls / Path to Desert Beach / Techichi Field 2 / 3 / Mirage Island Field 1.
Bring everything back to Magician Louie.

source.from: Drilled in Mirage Island Field 1 / 5 / 6 (drill depth not on the wiki)
Drilled in Pyramid Dungeon Halls / Path to Desert Beach / Techichi Field 2 / 3 / Mirage Island Field 1 (drill depth not on the wiki)
source.map: Pyramid Dungeon Halls / Path to Desert Beach / Techichi Field 2 / 3 / Mirage Island Field 1

quests.notes: Ancient Feather Pen is drilled in Mirage Island Field 1 / 5 / 6. Papyrus is drilled in Pyramid Dungeon Halls, Path to Desert Beach, Techichi Field 2 / 3, and Mirage Island Field 1. Besides a Magician and a Witch can completing this quest, only a Priest can learn Celestial Strike.

quests.title: Monkey T - Monkey T's Request
steps: Talk to Monkey T at Mirage Island Field 1 - Alteo.
Get 10x Panacea: dropped by Werepot (Lv.98) in Mirage Island Field 1 - Alteo.
Bring everything back to Monkey T (repeat 25 times).

quests.title: Rose Fairy Marion - Rose Fairy's First Test
quests.prereqText: Level 130+, have Rose Fairy's Message 1 in quest log
steps: Talk to Rose Fairy Marion at Nefertiti's Shrine.
Defeat 15x Tooth Rose (Lv.200) within 7 min in Nefertiti's Shrine.
Report back to Rose Fairy Marion.

quests.title: Rose Fairy Marion - Rose Fairy's Second Test
quests.prereqText: Level 130+, have Rose Fairy's Message 2 in quest log
steps: Talk to Rose Fairy Marion at Nefertiti's Shrine.
Defeat 15x Rose Worm (Lv.190) within 7 min in Nefertiti's Shrine.
Report back to Rose Fairy Marion.

quests.title: Spirit of Nefertiti - Gift from Nefertiti
steps: Talk to Spirit of Nefertiti at Another Dimension of Light.
Get 1x Soul Essence: reward from La Vida - Soul Essence.
Get 1x Essence of Life: reward from Frog Prince - Essence of Life.
Get 1x Elixir of Gods: reward from Atropos's Deal.
Bring everything back to Spirit of Nefertiti.

source.from: Reward from La Vida - Soul Essence
Reward from Frog Prince - Essence of Life

quests.notes: Soul Essence is obtained by completing La Vida - Soul Essence. Essence of Life is obtained by completing Frog Prince - Essence of Life. Elixir of Gods is obtained by completing Atropos's Deal. Spirit of Nefertiti will teleport you to Eclipse's Dimension. There, Eclipse will give you a Dimensional Key and offer teleportation to: Vamp Castle Parlor - Soul Sanctuary, Black Swamp - Site of Life, Rose Garden Park, and Another Dimension of Light.

quests.title: Spirit of Nefertiti - Be a True Trickster
quests.prereqText: Level 135+, 3rd Job, have completed Gift from Nefertiti, Poseidon Seed planted
steps: Talk to Spirit of Nefertiti at Another Dimension of Light.
Get 1x Questionable Letter: dropped by Win prize from Leveling Up (Lv.135) in Another Dimension of Light.
Get 1x Dimensional Key: dropped by Win the battle against Eclipse in Another Dimension of Light.
Bring everything back to Spirit of Nefertiti.
quests.notes: Questionable Letter is obtained upon reaching level 135, it will be rewarded and placed in your MyShop inventory. Dimensional Key is obtained from Eclipse in Eclipse's Dimension. This quest can't be done if the Poseidon Seed has hatched.
